    /**
     * `POST /uploads`
     */
    public suspend fun uploadBundle(body: UploadBundleRequest, options: RequestOptions = RequestOptions()): UploadBundleResponse {
        val parts = buildList {
            add(Part.Text("manifest", body.manifest))
            add(Part.File("artifact", body.artifact))
            body.sha256?.let { add(Part.Text("sha256", it)) }
        }
        return client.request<UploadBundleResponse>(
            RequestSpec(
                method = "POST",
                path = "/uploads",
                body = Body.Multipart(parts),
                options = options,
            )
        )
    }
